tolerance_rule: D124: half a unit of the last printed digit of each step; soil heat flux exactly. Amended by the lead developer on 14 November 2026, after the results were seen, for two steps where the example prints a result that does not match its own printed arithmetic: vapour_pressure_deficit (1.997 - 1.409 = 0.588, printed 0.589) and net_shortwave_radiation (0.77 x 22.07 = 16.9939, printed 17.00) are compared within one unit of the last printed digit (0.001 and 0.01). Recorded in issue #77 as D138 (https://github.com/gbarbozamar/field-shift-rotation-twin/issues/77#issuecomment-6887623727), which amends D124 for these two steps and states that it was decided after the results were seen.
tolerance_decided_by: Lead developer, explicit chat reply to the science integration session on 14 November 2026 ("Sí, las recomendadas"). A choice of the lead developer, not a value of the source. Recorded in issue #77 as D124: https://github.com/gbarbozamar/field-shift-rotation-twin/issues/77#issuecomment-6886937443
